note: One entry per dispatch printed on the page, in page order. Every URL below was opened and read while building this entry, and every page declares a 24 November 2026 publication date; the raw date string the page itself carries is quoted in date_on_page. Three dispatches from an earlier draft were dropped for want of such a page: Paris (Le Havre port authority inquiry), Jakarta (treason charge against a former police chief) and Kanton (Kiribati evacuation, published 23 November).

stories.headline: Iran says three tankers hit mines in Hormuz despite U.S. escort
stories.attribution: The mine strikes are the IRGC navy's account, carried by Iranian state media; the sanctions count is the U.S. Treasury's.

stories.headline: Houthis hit Riyadh's tallest tower, 11 wounded, Saudi Civil defense says
stories.attribution: The wounding toll and the attribution to a Houthi drone are Saudi civil defence's, as reported.

stories.headline: 23 injured after car bomb explodes outside government offices in Colombia
stories.attribution: The toll is the figure the report carries; the page names no claim of responsibility.

stories.headline: How major US stock indexes fared Tuesday 11/24/2026
stories.publisher: The Globe and Mail, carrying The Associated Press markets table
stories.attribution: Index levels and percentage moves are the AP table's closing figures.

stories.headline: Democrat Victoria Broderick unseats eight-term Republican incumbent in Tennessee
stories.attribution: The 259-seat total rests on the Associated Press race call cited in the report.

stories.headline: Claudia Sheinbaum exhorta al INE a revisar lineamientos de adquisiciones en OPLES
stories.attribution: The accusation of a 'mafia electoral' is President Sheinbaum's own phrase.

stories.headline: Lower House passes fiscal bill in decisive vote
stories.date_on_page: 2026-11-24 (date in the page address and in the report's dateline; the ballot itself was cast on 23 November)
stories.attribution: The 353-128 count is the chamber's recorded vote as reported; the exchange rate is the outlet's market note.

stories.headline: Russian overnight attack injures 22 in Zaporizhzhia
stories.attribution: The casualty figures are the regional governor's, as reported.

stories.headline: Russian retaliation over Ukrainian refinery strikes is inevitable, Putin says
stories.attribution: The word 'inevitable' is President Putin's, quoted by the outlet.

stories.headline: Latvian President sees potential turning point in Ukraine war next year
stories.attribution: The forecast is President Edgars Rinkevics's, not the outlet's.

stories.headline: EU imposes hard import quotas on Chinese hybrid cars, sweeping in UK and Japan
stories.attribution: The quota terms are reported from EU officials; the page cites no regulation text.

stories.headline: Volkswagen labor talks end without deal as union warns of January strikes
stories.attribution: The strike warning is IG Metall's; the no-deal account is the union's and the company's.

stories.headline: Revealed: Four clash points at centre of the RMT Tube strike row
stories.attribution: The walkout dates are the RMT's, as reported after talks failed.

stories.headline: DR Congo: Concern for trapped Ebola workers as violence against women and girls deepens
stories.attribution: The account of the maternity ward is the UN humanitarian office's.

stories.headline: Alamata shelling killed 14 civilians, Amnesty says
stories.attribution: The 14 dead and the call for a war crimes inquiry are Amnesty International's.

stories.headline: Outrage as 28 women, girls abducted, 15 cases of sexual violence against minors reported in Sudan's Blue Nile state
stories.attribution: The abduction figures come from local monitors and medical sources cited by Dabanga, not from the army or the RSF.

stories.headline: West Africa: Gold Refining Projects Already Exceed Mining Production
stories.attribution: The comparison of refining capacity with mined output is the analysis's own calculation.

stories.headline: Three Palestinians Martyred, Five Injured in Khan Younis Strike
stories.attribution: The toll is the figure given in the report; Israel's account of the target is not carried on the page.

stories.headline: Iraq Moves To Take Control Of Oilfields, Border Crossings In Kurdish Region
stories.attribution: The move is the federal government's; the Kurdish regional government rejects it, as reported.

stories.headline: South Korea scrambles jets as Russian warplanes enter air defense zone
stories.attribution: The incursion is the South Korean military's account; Moscow has not confirmed it here.

stories.headline: Hasina's December 16 homecoming plan: Bangladesh says ex-PM can be brought back only through extradition
stories.attribution: The 16 December date is Sheikh Hasina's announcement; the extradition position is the Bangladesh government's.

stories.headline: Singapore upgrades GDP forecast to around 6% for 2026, expects growth to moderate in 2027
stories.attribution: Growth and forecast are the Ministry of Trade and Industry's; the 5.4% comparison is MTI's own advance estimate.

stories.headline: Taiwan Weighted Closes 8.99% Higher on AI Rebound
stories.attribution: The close, the point gain and the percentage are the exchange's figures; the AI-rebound reading is the outlet's.

stories.headline: Gas explosion in Hanoi kills six, injures 10
stories.attribution: The toll is the figure in the report; the suspected gas leak is presented as the likely cause, not a finding.

stories.headline: Japan boosts ICC funding amid US sanctions threat

stories.headline: China's Shenzhou 24 mission lifts off, carrying first foreign astronaut to its space station
stories.attribution: The crew manifest is China's space programme's; the 'first foreign astronaut' framing is the outlet's.

stories.headline: Xiamen Airlines signs deal for 50 Boeing 737-8s
stories.attribution: The $7.4bn is the list price of the order, not a disclosed payment.

stories.attribution: The charge of betrayal is the Pacific Elders' Voice's.

stories.headline: Malaysia to repatriate another 6,803 Myanmar nationals despite ICJ genocide ruling
